text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. As we 
were passing by a convenience store—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Still-dono! Out on an outing with 
your Trainer, are you! To think you two 
would come to the sweets fair as well~!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Hello... Um... what is this sweets 
fair...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They're doing it at this convenience store 
starting today, apparently. A whole 
blowout lineup of new sweets. As an info 
broker, that feels like a must-check, 
right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking to pioneer a new side snack 
that goes with cola! I'd like to hear Sir 
Tran's thoughts on it as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! Why don't you two come look at 
the sweets with me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Especially Lady Still! Thou wert quite 
fond of sweets, wert thou not?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I'm down too~. Getting input from someone 
who knows snacks so well is super 
helpful."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's true. I love sweets, so if 
I can be of any help...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, there's quite a variety~! 'Hachimi 
Latte Pudding Parfait', 'Swirling Apple 
Galette'...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
They all look so delicious... Though 
eating all the new menu items is 
definitely more than I can handle.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then which one should I pick~? Personally, 
I wanna try a flavor I've never had 
before.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... In that case, how about this "Spiced 
Carrot Chai Cream Puff"?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Apparently they seasoned the cream with 
cardamom and ginger, so it should have a 
zesty and surprisingly refreshing taste...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Nice, nice! That sounds super fun!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If that be so, Lady Still. Among these new 
sweets, which dost thou reckon would best 
accompany cola?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... The sweetness of banana 
complements the carbonation of cola, so 
I'd recommend the "Banana & Chocoball."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Also, pairing something salty against the 
sweetness of cola creates a nice 
balance... So 'Carrot Crackers' should go 
well with it too.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm...! Both options are so appealing, 
aye...!

"After picking out their respective 
sweets, Still in Love and the others 
decided to enjoy them at a nearby park 
under the clear skies and pleasant 
breeze."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That cream puff was totally unfair~~. 
Looking all sweet like a regular puff, but 
hitting you with that subtle spicy 
punch... I'm completely hooked now.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, truly exquisite~♪ Lady Still's 
recommendation of cola was going down so 
easily, my belly feels fit to burst.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm glad it suited your taste.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, what did Still 
choose?

Come to think of it, what did Still 
choose?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I would like this one... The "Honey and 
Apple Biscuits."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that looks delicious too! What kind 
of flavor does it have?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, let's see... Well then, just a bite...
(Crunch. Munch, munch, munch...)

Still in Love gently holds the biscuit, 
nibbling on it little by little as if 
treasuring every bite. And then, looking 
reluctant to finish it, she takes the last 
piece—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*... Phew. ...It has a gentle 
sweetness, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The Hachimi softly melts over the tongue, 
followed by the crisp tartness of apple... 
It's a flavor that somehow stirs the 
soul...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... When sweetness and sourness come 
together like this, it makes my heart 
flutter...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Um? Is something the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man... Still-chan's review is just 
completely overflowing with love for 
sweets~

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you're exaggerating... I only said 
what came to mind...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay, nay, that blissful expression of hers 
as she savored it! The pastry she devoured 
must surely have fulfilled its purpose.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: E-Eh...? What kind of face am I making...?
choice_data_list: You had such a happy look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Umm... Well... you see...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... Please... don't look at me 
so much...

Still in Love looks down bashfully. Yet, 
lingering around her lips is a smile 
tinged with delight.
choice_data_list:
If you don't mind, tell me what snacks 
you'd recommend too!

If you don't mind, tell me what sweets 
you'd recommend too!

You should be much prouder of your love 
for sweets!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My... recommendation...?
choice_data_list:
If you recommend it, I'm sure it must be 
delicious.

If it's your recommendation, I'm sure 
it'll be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ……! Trainer……

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... um... Let's go pick some out next 
time... Your sweets, together...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Your love for sweets is unmatched 
under the sun! Ye have our full stamp of 
approval, aye!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah. If Still-chan spreads the charm 
of sweets and all that, wouldn't that make 
way more people happy?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Um... thank you so much.
